definitions.explanation: A person whose profession or main pursuit is music — composing, conducting, or performing. Slightly formal in tone; suggests a serious classical or career musician rather than a casual player.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{音楽家|おんがくか}だ。
⟦{将来|しょうらい}→将来：01438_shourai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{音楽家|おんがくか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりたい→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I want to become a musician in the future.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{音楽家|おんがくか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{若|わか}い{頃|ころ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{交響曲|こうきょうきょく}→交響曲：18025_koukyoukyoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作曲|さっきょく}→作曲：02824_sakkyoku⟧してきた。
examples.english: That musician has composed many symphonies since he was young.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧ (music) + ⟦{家|か}→〜家：28339_ka⟧ (specialist; "-ist"). Tends to imply a serious or professional pursuit, especially in classical music.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {音楽家|おんがくか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become a musician
- {若|わか}い{音楽家|おんがくか}: a young musician
- ⟦プロ→プロ：03871_puro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{音楽家|おんがくか}: professional musician

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ミュージシャン: musician — broader and more contemporary, includes pop/rock players
- ⟦{演奏家|えんそうか}→演奏家：29184_ensouka⟧: performer; instrumentalist — focuses on playing rather than composing
- {作曲家|さっきょくか}: composer — specifically a music writer
